method: AI-assisted nonclinical image-correspondence inspection of four rendered contact sheets; six pairs per sheet; each image displayed within a 540-by-245 pixel panel
selection: Top 24 of 814 pHash-screened pairs ranked by full-image 160-pixel letterbox grayscale Pearson correlation
observation: The displayed pairs show differences in framing, positioning, grayscale appearance, marker position, or visible structures. No pair was confirmed to be a transformed copy from this inspection.
patient_identity_inference: None. Different image appearance cannot establish different patients or rule out repeated acquisitions.
clinical_label_review: Not performed; no clinical or diagnostic adjudication
limitations: Selected thumbnail subset; 790 screen candidates not reviewed in this pass
Image registration, complete high-resolution adjudication, and independent expert review were not performed
Perceptual hashes and pixel correlation can miss transformed copies and flag common anatomy
No claim that all duplicates are absent or that every group is a separate patient
image_publication: Contact sheets remain local artifacts; public release contains candidate metadata and reproducible code
